headline: SKIL Infrastructure advances to 7th Committee of Creditors meeting in CIRP
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited convened its 7th Committee of Creditors meeting on 1 July 2026 as part of its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The pre-facto intimation to NSE signals progress in the resolution phase, with the CoC evaluating revised resolution plans or creditor claims.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure-sector entity, is in CIRP under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The 7th CoC meeting on 1 July 2026 follows prior sessions and represents material progression in the resolution window. The NSE intimation requirement reflects mandatory disclosure obligations for listed entities undergoing insolvency. The frequency of CoC meetings suggests either complex multi-stakeholder creditor dynamics, prior plan rejections, or rolling plan submissions—all common in large infrastructure insolvencies where debt is fragmented across banks, NCDs, trade creditors and operational stakeholders.
